title: the portable math functions by default, and the reference values recorded with them
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG4.1.3.4: EXUDYN_PORTABLE_MATH is defined in BasicDefinitions.h unless EXUDYN_LIBRARY_MATH is set; the reference values of the test models, mini examples, fast module and performance tests that move are recorded again; UnresolvedOnLinux() loses the models that agree now; UnresolvedOnMacOS() stays until the measurement on macOS ARM
releaseNotes: the math functions of Exudyn are the portable ones by default (EXUDYN_PORTABLE_MATH; EXUDYN_LIBRARY_MATH selects the library to compare with): results agree between Windows and Linux to the last bit in all but three test models; 53 reference values, 16 of the fast module and one performance reference recorded again, UnresolvedOnLinux() reduced from twelve to three models
